items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I worked at the Derby Cafe and I had Zutty and another guy who played the drums named Freddy Bryant and people like that working with me there.

ctx.x: And Chicago was all right. I knew these people that were supposed to be so-called gangsters. So I went down to

22nd and Ceimac Road, right across from Big Jim Colisimo's and got a job at a place called the Derby Cafe. And I worked at the Derby Cafe and I had Zutty and another guy who played the drums named Freddy Bryant and people like that working with me there. So I stayed in Chicago through the summer with the Fair. And when the Fair was over...
